Leader 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant · GRC Tools, Assurance Leaders Leaders Quadrant 2025 Verdantix Green Quadrant · GRC Software Top Score Compliance Management · Q2 2026 Forrester WAVE GRC THE CHALLENGE Regulatory change is outrunning the systems built to manage it. Most large compliance programs run on a platform, not designed for today's pace of regulatory change. Regulatory information sits in spreadsheets, niche tools, document repositories, and individual analyst memories. There is no central, current, quarriable view of every obligation the business is subject to. When a regulator asks a question, the answer depends on which analyst is in the room and which spreadsheet is the most recent. THE PACE OF CHANGE 200+ regulatory changes are released every day. The average regulated institution tracks 200+ regulatory changes daily across jurisdictions, agencies, and frameworks (Thomson Reuters, 2024). Regulations are outpacing what compliance teams can track. RULES IN MOTION Regulatory whack-a-mole - regulations keep changing direction Rules no longer hold still long enough for compliance teams to retool. By the time a control is deployed, the underlying obligation has moved. NEW AI REGULATIONS Generic AI cannot prove its work. Regulators now require documented proof of how and where AI is used in compliance decisions. They expect an auditable record of what the AI concluded, how it reached that conclusion, and what trail it left behind. Generic LLMs produce error rates up to 94% on domain-specific compliance queries. Bolt-on logging is not an audit trail. The compliance programs that will stand up to tomorrow's scrutiny cannot be built on infrastructure designed for yesterday's pace. WHAT IS ARCHER EVOLV COMPLIANCE Defensible compliance on a single data foundation. Archer Evolv Compliance is the enterprise compliance management solution that connects regulatory intelligence to obligations, controls, evidence, and assurance activity with full lineage from source to outcome. Standalone or as a seamless extension of any Archer installation, on-prem or SaaS. Intelligent horizon scanning across 4,500+ regulatory sources Automated obligation extraction with calibrated confidence AI gap analysis with proposed resolutions, not just alerts Continuous control mapping with auto-generated controls Policy authoring, alignment, and enforcement alerts Examiner-ready audit evidence with full lineage Strategic scenario simulation for market entry, M&A, and regulatory readiness Built for enterprises Where compliance is a business-critical function Who own the program, not just the audit Designed for leaders Built for regulatory environments That moves faster than human teams can THE CAPABILITY MAP Everything a defensible compliance program needs, in one platform. Eighteen named capabilities organised into the three stages of the compliance programs. Each capability is delivered by AI Operators and emits structured evidence to the same audit plane. 01 THE DIFFERENTIATION Sense regulatory change. Prioritise the response Horizon scanning AI monitors 4,500+ regulatory sources across 170 jurisdictions and 40 languages. Business Profile wizard Captures jurisdictions, products, and lines of business to filter only relevant change. Requirement Analyzer Extracts obligations from raw regulatory text with calibrated confidence. AI gap analysis Compares obligations to current controls and proposes resolutions. Materiality scoring Ranks change by jurisdictional, operational, and financial impact. Bring Your Own Content (BYOC) Ingest corporate policies, internal standards, and licensing terms alongside regulation. 02 ACT Route work. Update policy. Execute response. Obligation library One master catalog of every regulatory and corporate obligation, in one place. Control mapping Continuous auto-mapping from obligation to control, with versioning. Policy authoring & alignment Draft, align, version, and enforce policy with AI assistance. Workflow orchestration Route impact assessments, attestations, and remediation with named owners. Issue and action management Track remediation from finding to closure with full audit history. Strategic scenario simulation Forward-model market entry, M&A, product launch, DORA, and EU AI Act readiness. 03 ASSURE AND LEARN Produce evidence. Prove the program. Improve continuously. Continuous lineage graph Source to obligation to control to evidence, queryable years later. Examiner-ready evidence packs Pre-built outputs for regulators, auditors, and the board. Immutable audit plane Every AI Operator action emits actor, intent, model, inputs, outputs, confidence, justification. Expert-in-the-Loop review 130+ in-house regulatory specialists supervise AI outputs. Board and committee reporting Configurable dashboards with named-program KPIs. Learning loop Recommendations refine from outcomes and expert signal across the Archer customer base. THE DIFFERENTIATION Three pillars: the combination no one can replicate. Archer's advantage is not one capability. It is the combination of capabilities built for compliance, the data foundation underneath it, and the domain capabilities sitting on top. Without slowing what they can do. GENERIC AI AGENT Impressive in demos. Indefensible in audits.
